title: E-rideables and share scheme parking on footpaths
note: Cl.137 defines a 'wheeled recreational vehicle' around mini bikes and Segways and predates hire e-scooters entirely. Need a head of power for corral parking, impoundment and operator agreements that does not conflict with the Road Safety Road Rules.

title: Make parklets and streateries a permanent permit class
note: Outdoor dining structures were stood up under emergency arrangements and have run on extensions since. The Footpath Trading Policy is incorporated under cl.19(3), so the policy and the law have to move together.

title: Lower the Significant Tree trigger and add a canopy test
note: Current trigger is 140cm circumference at 1.4m (or 180cm at base). Arborists argue this misses medium-maturity canopy on small lots. Options: lower threshold, add a canopy-spread test, or a species schedule.

title: Bring the Nature Strip Planting Policy inside the law
note: Cl.110(4) refers to the Nature Strip Planting Policy but, unlike the Footpath Trading and Keeping of Animals policies, it is not an incorporated document under cl.19. Inconsistent enforceability.

title: Remove the 25-trolley exemption for shopping trolleys
note: Cl.125(2) exempts operators with 25 trolleys or fewer, which covers the small supermarkets generating most of the abandoned-trolley reports.

title: Align noise Table 2 with the EPA Environment Reference Standard
note: Table 2 prohibited hours sit alongside the Environment Protection Regulations 2021 residential noise provisions. Officers report confusion about which instrument to use; risk of an inconsistency argument on review.

title: Review the 65dB amplified-music standard for entertainment precincts
note: Cl.144(6) sets speaker placement rules and 65dB (LA max) at 2m from an adjoining facade. Contested from both directions in Prahran and Windsor.

title: Camping provisions and the Human Rights Charter
note: Cl.143(3)-(4) prohibit camping and leaving personal effects on Council land. Charter s.12 (freedom of movement), s.13 (privacy) and s.17 (protection of families) engagement must be documented, with an assertive-outreach-first operating protocol.

title: Cat containment / curfew under the Keeping of Animals Policy
note: Made under s.42 Domestic Animals Act 1994. Neighbouring councils have moved; this is the single most likely source of submission volume.

title: Building activity hours and construction management on major works
note: Requests to allow extended hours for concrete pours and crane work in exchange for a construction management plan and community liaison obligations.

title: Reset asset protection bond levels and exemption classes
note: Bond levels are set through the Procedure and Protocol Manual. Confirm whether the quantum belongs in the law, the manual or the fees schedule.

title: Tiered filming permits for small-crew and social content
note: Cl.136 captures any commercial filming on Council land. A single-operator shoot and a feature unit are treated identically.

title: Drone operation over Council reserves
note: Cl.123(1)(a) bans drones unless the reserve is exempted in the Procedure and Protocol Manual. CASA holds airspace control — confirm the limits of Council's power over take-off and landing only.

title: EV charging cables across footpaths and kerbside charging
note: Residents without off-street parking are running cables across footpaths. Currently an obstruction under cl.127 with no permit pathway. Interacts with the residential parking permit scheme.

title: Clothing bins — separate charitable from commercial collection
note: Sitting since 2019. Dumping around commercial bins drives most of the cost; a permit condition set may be enough without a drafting change.

title: Real estate signage over footpaths and on facades
note: Cl.145(3) requires a permit for signage over a verandah or footpath. Enforcement is effectively complaint-driven; industry expects a standing arrangement.

title: Bin presentation times and bin storage on nature strips
note: No presentation window in the current law. Four-stream rollout has increased bins left out; interacts with the state's FOGO requirements.

title: Commercial use of open space — personal training and boot camps
note: Cl.122(o) requires a permit for paid personal training. Group size, turf wear and fee structure are unresolved.

title: Accessible footpath clear width as a hard standard
note: The Disability Advisory Committee has asked for a minimum continuous accessible path set in the law rather than the policy, so it survives policy amendment.

title: Repeal spent Common Seal and machinery clauses
note: Part 4 was repealed in 2023 and moved to the Governance Rules. Part 3 largely duplicates the Governance Rules. Definitions still reference the Local Government Act 1989 throughout.

title: Infringement schedule and penalty level review
note: Cl.198 caps at 20 penalty units, with 2 units per day for continuing offences. Test whether current infringement levels deter tree removal and illegal works, where the commercial gain exceeds the penalty.

title: Short-stay accommodation amenity and party-house noise
note: State short-stay levy and the Owners Corporations regime cover part of this. Need legal advice on what is left for a local law to do before scoping drafting.

title: Consolidate directive powers and add a review right
note: Directive powers appear in at least four places with different wording. Cl.16 gives 28 days to be heard but does not stay the notice. Audit recommended one consistent procedural code.

title: Designated alcohol-free areas — evidence review
note: Blanket prohibition under cl.129 with exemptions by permit. Police support retention; equity concerns raised about enforcement patterns.
